public_rationale: The readable sources distinguish estimated serving economics from demonstrated realized margins. None establishes the relevant 90%+ figure. That does not prove Zitron's stronger assertion that it was completely unproven: the underlying evidence for the specific investor claims was not fully accessible. Neither side is settled by the admitted record.
limitations: The claim does not define inference margin or identify the exact business coverage.
Relevant analyst material was excluded because read_page marked it PARTIAL.
The admitted examples concern other dates and narrower serving configurations.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Claims that AI labs have 90%+ inference margins are completely unproven.

statement.excerpt: which is why you have noted venture capitalists claiming that AI labs have “90%+ inference margins,” a completely unproven statement that AI boosters cling to and repeat often enough that it’s taken as gospel

our_interpretation: This concerns whether the margin assertion had been substantiated publicly by publication, not whether such margins are economically possible.
The plain reading of inference margin is inference revenue less attributable serving costs, divided by inference revenue, excluding training and unrelated corporate expenses.
Allow evidence for the specific lab, product or API business actually covered by the margin assertion; do not require company-wide net profitability.
Use July 15, 2026 as a snapshot of the public evidence record. A financial reporting quarter would answer a different question.
Audited accounts would be strong evidence, but credible disclosures or independently substantiated measurements could also demonstrate the figure.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive examination of the relevant public claims and their underlying evidence establishes that the 90%+ assertions remained assumptions or unsupported estimates as of July 15, 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one relevant 90%+ inference-margin assertion had already been demonstrated through disclosed or independently substantiated revenue and serving-cost figures on a matching basis.

It documents why an estimated margin is not automatically a demonstrated realized margin, but cannot establish the absence of all relevant proof in July.

evidence.locator: Inference statistics and theoretical revenue discussion
evidence.explanation: DeepSeek disclosed serving statistics but calculated hypothetical revenue by applying one pricing schedule to traffic that included free services. This is relevant disclosure, not proof of realized 90%+ margins for the labs covered by the claim.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: The original 90%+ assertions and their supporting records as available by July 15, 2026, including matching revenue, serving costs, product coverage and calculation methods.
